Anagram Solver

Rearrange all of your letters into real words, with the most common words first.

Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is uploaded.

Words you can spell will show up here.

Words from the ENABLE word list. Not an official tournament word list.

Offensive words are hidden. Letters filled by a ? or * wildcard are underlined.

Use all letters is selected at the start. Up to 15 letters, plus at most 2 wildcards (? or *). The list shows 500 words at a time.

Need shorter words too? Try Unscramble Words.

Rearrange every letter

An anagram uses ALL of the letters, in a new order. Use this page to solve a word puzzle or to make a puzzle from a word you chose.

How to use

  1. Type the word you want to rearrange into "Your letters".

  2. Leave "Use all letters" selected so every letter has to be used.

  3. Press "Find words". Copy a full rearrangement to solve or make a puzzle.

Example

Jordan is writing a puzzle and checks every rearrangement of LISTEN.

BeforeAfter
 
LISTEN
listen, silent, enlist, inlets, tinsel, elints

FAQ

How do I solve a word puzzle?

Type the letters, leave Use all letters selected, and press Find words. The first words use every letter.

How do I make a puzzle?

Type a word, press Find words, and pick another word that uses the same letters. That pair is the puzzle.

Why do listen and silent come first?

Those two use every letter of LISTEN, and common words come first inside that length.
